title: Second Craft
hints: Read .claude/skills/well-wisher/SKILL.md — the description is technically true, but true enough to match almost anything positive.
A good description says what the skill is actually for, specifically — wishing someone well, blessings, good fortune — not just "nice."
If your new description still says something as broad as "says something nice," it'll fire on compliment requests too — that's the trap.
